lessons.title: Presente perfecto continuo
lessons.goal: Habla de acciones que llevan tiempo ocurriendo
tip: have/has been + verbo en -ing: I have been studying.
Se usa con for/since: I have been working here since 2020.
Si está terminado y completo, usa el simple: I have written three reports.

phrases.t: I have been looking for a job for two hours

phrases.es: Ha estado lloviendo toda la mañana
phrases.t: It has been raining all morning
How long have you been working here?

pair.t: She has been working here since 2020.

exercises.prompt: I'm tired because I ___ all day.

pair.es: Estoy cansado porque llevo todo el día estudiando.
pair.t: I have been studying all day.

exercises.explain: Acción que continúa todo el día: perfecto continuo.

exercises.solution: I have been waiting since nine

pair.t: I have been waiting since nine

exercises.audio: He has been learning English for three years.

pair.t: He has been learning English for three years.
I have been studying

exercises.prompt: How long ___ you been learning German?

pair.t: How long have you been learning German?

lessons.title: Gerundio o infinitivo
lessons.goal: Elige bien entre -ing y «to» tras cada verbo
tip: enjoy, finish, suggest, avoid + -ing: I enjoy working in a team.
want, decide, hope, need + to: I decided to change jobs.
Tras preposición siempre -ing: I'm thinking of moving.

phrases.t: I enjoy working in a team
I have decided to change jobs

pair.t: I enjoy learning new languages.
She decided to start a new course.

exercises.prompt: Traduce: «He decidido buscar un nuevo trabajo»
exercises.solution: I have decided to look for a new job

pair.es: He decidido buscar un nuevo trabajo
pair.t: I have decided to look for a new job

exercises.audio: They suggested going to the meeting together.

Decidieron ir juntos a la reunión.
Se negaron a ir juntos a la reunión.

pair.t: I am thinking of changing my career.

lessons.title: Phrasal verbs de trabajo
lessons.goal: Domina los verbos compuestos básicos del mundo laboral
tip: apply for a job = solicitar un puesto; fill in a form = rellenar un formulario.
hand in = entregar; take on = contratar; set up = montar (una empresa).
carry out = llevar a cabo (un plan, un proyecto).

phrases.t: I'm going to apply for that position
Fill in the form and hand it in

phrases.es: Llevó a cabo el proyecto él solo
phrases.t: He carried out the project on his own

exercises.sentence: I want to ___ for the manager position.

pair.es: Quiero presentarme para el puesto de gerente.
pair.t: I want to apply for the manager position.
Carry out

exercises.solution: She set up her own company

pair.t: She set up her own company

exercises.audio: Please fill in this form and hand it in before Friday.
options: Rellena este formulario y entrégalo antes del viernes.
Rellena este formulario y envíalo por correo el viernes.
Guarda este formulario hasta el viernes.

pair.es: Rellena este formulario y entrégalo antes del viernes.
pair.t: Please fill in this form and hand it in before Friday.
Look for

exercises.prompt: The company will ___ five new engineers.

pair.es: La empresa contratará a cinco ingenieros nuevos.
pair.t: The company will take on five new engineers.

lessons.title: Collocations para entrevistas
lessons.goal: Habla de tu perfil profesional con combinaciones naturales
tip: responsible for = responsable de; in charge of = a cargo de.
good at + -ing = se me da bien; interested in = interesado en.
deal with = tratar con / gestionar (clientes, problemas, presión).

phrases.t: I am responsible for three projects

phrases.es: Se me dan bien los idiomas

phrases.t: I can deal with difficult clients

exercises.sentence: She is responsible ___ the marketing team.

pair.es: Es responsable del equipo de marketing.
pair.t: She is responsible for the marketing team.

pair.es: Se me da bien resolver problemas.
pair.t: I am good at solving problems.

exercises.solution: I am interested in the position

pair.t: I am interested in the position

exercises.audio: In my last job I was in charge of customer service.
options: En mi último trabajo estaba a cargo de atención al cliente.
En mi último trabajo trabajé con atención al cliente.
En mi último trabajo dirigí toda la empresa.

pair.es: En mi último trabajo estaba a cargo de atención al cliente.
pair.t: In my last job I was in charge of customer service.
